reference.atlas: Brain/MINDS BMA2023 Reference Brain Atlas Ver.3.0
reference.coordinateMeaning: Native image u-right,v-down continuous pixels. Scene uses centered image X-right,Y-up and relative reference slice axis. No Bregma/absolute AP interpretation.
reference.rawMSIPixelConvention: Raw image continuous pixel coordinates; measured pixel i,j is represented by i+0.5,j+0.5.
reference.hemisphereEvidence: Official SVG _R labels occur on native image left; official viewer source maps _R to right.
reference.referenceSliceAssignments: 68 stored references retained exactly, including duplicate and reversal; Cor_13_7 s545 is midpoint interpolation of 532 and558, explicitly flagged.
reference.acceptanceScope: User accepted the eight-section pilot for proceeding to all69. Remaining61 do not have independently confirmed landmark correspondences. No claim of anatomical validation.
reference.method: Original HE color-mask centroid in raw HE is transformed by saved HE-to-MSI matrix. At accepted8 anchors, offset between transformed HE centroid and native Atlas right-side mask centroid is computed. Residual angle and centroid offset are linearly interpolated in s, with endpoint holding outside anchors. Each other section uses its own Atlas mask centroid plus interpolated offset and preserves nominal saved orientation, physical pixel pitch, no mirror and no scale deformation.
reference.maskConvention: HE: channel range>14, R-G>6,B-G>4; closing2,fillholes; retain components >=max(60px,10%largest). Native Atlas T2 mean>35,close1,fillholes,right half u<360,open1; retain components>=max(30px,1%largest). Significant fragments retained; these are image envelopes, not manually certified tissue boundaries.
reference.orientationPolicy: Nominal raw MSI image rotation = saved rotation.all + rotation.msi - 180 degrees, then accepted/interpolated residual. No automated reflection or180-degree search.
reference.defaultModeIntent: Reversible app preset; source cloud poses are preserved, not rewritten.
reference.rawDataFingerprintProvenance: source.rawFingerprint supplied by parent via official ZipIO import + Normalization.fingerprint on the corresponding full raw dataset; not derived by this Python image-processing script.

summary.dataScope: Local output only. App repository and cloud not modified by this generation.
